 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Medhi
 Order

26.09.2025 Heard Shri A.R. Bhuyan, learned counsel for the petitioners, who are aggrieved by acquisition process which has been initiated under the Assam Land (Requisition and Acquisition)
Act, 1964.
It is the contention of the petitioners that they were allotted lands which have been acquired for the Thermal Power Project.
The cause of action is however pertaining to a part of the land which, according to the petitioners is not a part of the project for which the acquisition process has been initiated.
Let notice be issued, returnable by 6(six) weeks.

Ms. P.R. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1 whereas Shri P.N. Goswami, learned Additional Advocate General accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 2 & 3 and Shri K.P. Pathak, learned Standing Counsel, APDCL accepts notice on Page No.# 3/3 behalf of the respondent no. 4.
Extra copies of the writ petition be served upon the learned counsel for the respondents within two working days.
Shri Bhuyan, learned counsel for the petitioners prays for an interim order.

2 The law relating to acquisition of land is well settled and unless there is a case made out wherein there are violation of the statute, such acquisition process cannot be challenged and the only aspect is would be on the question of adequate compensation.
In view of the above, this Court is not inclined to pass any blanket interim order.
It is needless to state that all the petitioners and the interested persons would be entitled to a fair and adequate compensation under the statute holding the field.
